resources.string:
First time: enter the box's Bluetooth address (box Settings → About → Status) and tap Connect. Confirm the pairing on both the phone and the TV. The app reconnects by itself next time, and keeps retrying for 3 minutes after the link drops. Once connected it stays connected in the background and with the phone locked, and the notification can put the box in standby or disconnect. While connected, the phone's volume keys change the box volume.

TV turns only the TV on or off over HDMI-CEC. The Touchpad button in the middle swaps the D-pad for a swipe pad: one swipe moves one item, rest your finger after a swipe to keep moving.

The power key needs the N1 standby helper on the box: in standby the box goes home, blanks the screen and HDMI signal, asks the TV to sleep over CEC and ignores other keys. Press it again to wake.
